Looking up the input-controlled Length entry resolves the indirect reference through the document XRef.

Resolving the untrusted Length reference can reconstruct the XRef table while makeStream still holds an XRefEntry pointer captured before the lookup; the entry pointer should remain valid until it is reused.
The missing referenced Length object drives XRef::fetch down its recovery path, reconstructing the xref entries array and invalidating the earlier XRefEntry pointer.
Parser::makeStream reuses the stale XRefEntry pointer and setFlag reads and writes the flags field from freed xref entry storage.
